authorisations.title: Class 6
authorisations.description: Certified handlers in control of class 6 substances
authorisations.regulation: Regulations 4.1 and 13.9, Health and Safety at Work (Hazardous Substances) Regulations 2017
authorisations.scope: The certification of handlers (class 6) does not include agrichemicals.

authorisations.title: Fumigants
authorisations.description: Certified handlers in control of Fumigants
authorisations.regulation: Regulations 4.1 and 14.3, Health and Safety at Work (Hazardous Substances) Regulations 2017
authorisations.scope: The certification of handlers (fumigants) is authorised for the following substances: aluminium phosphide; chloropicrin; dichloropropene; dichloropropene & chloropicrin; hydrocyanic acid; magnesium phosphide; methyl bromide; phosphine

authorisations.title: Vertebrate Toxic Agents
authorisations.description: Certified handlers in control of Vertebrate Toxic Agents
authorisations.regulation: Regulations 4.1 and 13.9, Health and Safety at Work (Hazardous Substances) Regulations 2017
authorisations.scope: The certification of handlers (vertebrate toxic agents) is authorised for the following substances: sodium cyanide; potassium cyanide; para-aminopropiophenone (PAPP); sodium fluoroacetate (1080)

authorisations.title: Importation
authorisations.regulation: Regulation 15.16, Health and Safety at Work (Hazardous Substances) Regulations 2017

authorisations.title: UNRTDG
authorisations.regulation: Regulation 15.3(3), Health and Safety at Work (Hazardous Substances) Regulations 2017

authorisations.title: Classes 6 or 8
authorisations.description: Locations where classes 6 or 8 substances are present
authorisations.regulation: Regulation 13.38, Health and Safety at Work (Hazardous Substances) Regulations 2017
authorisations.scope: The certification of locations where class 6 or 8 substances are present is limited to storage in packages up to a maximum quantity of 5,000 kg or 5,000 L.

authorisations.title: Class 2.1.1
authorisations.description: Locations where class 2.1.1 (flammable gas) substances are present
authorisations.regulation: Regulation 10.34, Health and Safety at Work (Hazardous Substances) Regulations 2017
authorisations.scope: The certification of locations where class 2.1.1 substances are present is limited to packages and cylinders up to a maximum quantity of 2,000 kg.
authorisations.source: Scope of Work, Appendix A (19 October 2026)

authorisations.title: Class 2.1.2 aerosols
authorisations.description: Locations where class 2.1.2 (flammable aerosol) substances are present
authorisations.regulation: Regulation 10.34, Health and Safety at Work (Hazardous Substances) Regulations 2017
authorisations.scope: The certification of locations where class 2.1.2 aerosols are present is limited to an aggregate water capacity of up to 100,000 L.
authorisations.source: Scope of Work, Appendix A (19 October 2026)

authorisations.title: Class 3.1
authorisations.description: Locations where class 3.1 (flammable liquid) substances are present
authorisations.regulation: Regulation 10.34, Health and Safety at Work (Hazardous Substances) Regulations 2017
authorisations.scope: The certification of locations where class 3.1 substances are present is limited to: packages in one or more cabinets; a separate building or external storage area up to 10,000 L; a store in a building up to 10,000 L; stationary container systems up to 10,000 L; retail shops under regulations 11.32 and 11.33; use up to 450 L; paint mixing rooms to AS/NZS 4114.
authorisations.source: Scope of Work, Appendix A (19 October 2026)

authorisations.title: Class 4.1.1
authorisations.description: Locations where class 4.1.1 (flammable solid) substances are present
authorisations.regulation: Regulation 10.36, Health and Safety at Work (Hazardous Substances) Regulations 2017
authorisations.scope: The certification of locations where class 4.1.1 substances are present is limited to packages up to a maximum quantity of 2,000 kg or 2,000 L.
authorisations.source: Scope of Work, Appendix A (19 October 2026)
authorisations.note: Sheet set class_3_2_4 (the Argenta "Class 3.2 and 4" tab) is offered under this entry. Appendix A lists 4.1.1 only: classes 3.2 and 4.1.2A to F are not on the register. Open question to the owner before any 3.2 or 4.1.2 substance is certified (reg 6.22(1)).

authorisations.title: Class 5.1.1
authorisations.description: Locations where class 5.1.1 (oxidising) substances are present
authorisations.regulation: Regulation 12.17, Health and Safety at Work (Hazardous Substances) Regulations 2017
authorisations.scope: The certification of locations where class 5.1.1 substances are present is limited to packages up to a maximum quantity of 30,000 kg or 30,000 L, and stationary containers up to 30,000 L.
authorisations.source: Scope of Work, Appendix A (19 October 2026)

authorisations.title: Existing above and below ground tanks
authorisations.description: Existing above ground and below ground stationary tanks
authorisations.regulation: Regulation 17.91(2) and 17.91(2)(b)(iii), Health and Safety at Work (Hazardous Substances) Regulations 2017
authorisations.scope: The certification of existing above ground and below ground stationary tanks is limited to tanks up to 60,000 L each.
exclusions: Repair or alteration of above ground and below ground tanks
authorisations.source: Scope of Work, Appendix A (19 October 2026)

authorisations.title: Dispensers
authorisations.regulation: Regulation 17.91(2)(m), Health and Safety at Work (Hazardous Substances) Regulations 2017
exclusions: Repair or alteration of above ground and below ground tanks
authorisations.source: Scope of Work, Appendix A (19 October 2026)

authorisations.title: Process containers
authorisations.regulation: Regulation 17.91(2)(e), Health and Safety at Work (Hazardous Substances) Regulations 2017
exclusions: Repair or alteration of above ground and below ground tanks
authorisations.source: Scope of Work, Appendix A (19 October 2026)

conditions: Mr Wilson must perform the functions of a compliance certifier in an objective manner that promotes safety.
Mr Wilson must remain a fit and proper person throughout the period of this authorisation.
